scientific_question: Can fixed greedy decoding rescue or clarify the SUCCESS adapter's closed-loop degradation across the frozen H0 task panel?
hypothesis: If the degradation is caused by stochastic action calibration, greedy decoding will reduce max-step failures or improve SUCCESS relative to BASE; if not, the issue is representation/state distribution rather than sampling noise.

task_panel.source: H0 train-only task manifest; no task is used for H1.2 training

primary_metrics: qualified_positive_rate among valid episodes by arm/regime/task
cell_factors: 3 arms x 2 decoding regimes x 2 task partitions = 12 cells; each cell has 2 tasks x 4 seeds = 8 attempts
gpu_policy: one UUID-bound process per cell; wave 1 uses 8 GPUs, wave 2 starts only after required GPUs are idle

tracking.full_traces: local atomic episode files; W&B compact summaries

stop_branch.greedy_rescue: queue a new recovery/action-calibration protocol using the same adapters; do not open D0
stop_branch.no_rescue: retain negative decoding evidence and diagnose state distribution/representation before training changes
stop_branch.runtime_or_parser_failure: exclude from efficacy metrics, preserve artifacts, repair runtime without protocol changes

claim_boundary: H1.2 is a bounded decoding/transfer diagnostic; it cannot establish overall WebShop benchmark improvement.
